# Assets licenses

Every file under `.github/assets/` is listed here with its author, license and date (`assert_assets_licenses_listed`).
The drawings are flat shapes made for the project; there is no third-party art, photograph or screenshot. The ghost icon
is the one of `runtime/packages/ui/icons/sym-ghost.svg`. License of a file: AGPL-3.0-only for the file itself. The name
and the logo stay under the trademark policy (`runtime/TRADEMARK.md`): the license of a file does not grant a right on them.

## Fonts used to render the PNG files

The text of the banners and of the social preview is set in three typefaces, self-hosted in `runtime/packages/ui/fonts/`
(subsets, latin) and rendered by `pnpm assets:render`. They are not shipped under `.github/assets/`.

| Typeface | Author | License | Text of the license |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bricolage Grotesque 800 | The Bricolage Grotesque Project Authors (2022) | SIL OFL 1.1 | `runtime/packages/ui/fonts/OFL-bricolage-grotesque.txt` |
| DM Sans | The DM Sans Project Authors (2014) | SIL OFL 1.1 | `runtime/packages/ui/fonts/OFL-dm-sans.txt` |
| JetBrains Mono 600 | The JetBrains Mono Project Authors (2020) | SIL OFL 1.1 | `runtime/packages/ui/fonts/OFL-jetbrains-mono.txt` |
